scenes.outline: Parent copied headteacher calendar crossings as suspension dates; child identifies holidays; parent covers confusion by giving less factual and more emotional reassurance.
Courier clerk copies customer pointing as depot confirmation but it is wedding venue; A covers through warm narrowing of information.
Coworkers at coffee; A copies two fingers as two names total, B orders coffees; A covers and prices secrets at matching granularity.
Siblings waiting for bus; A copies pound coin as secret ritual, B fare money; A covers then prices admissions by punishment.
Fundraising helpers; A copies pen-down as statement completion, B ran out of ink; A preserves confidence and answers with tighter timing definitions.
Partners discussing birthday account; A copies swipe as deletion, B only closes preview; A covers by narrowing dinner and eating definitions.
Household pair; A copies washing-up gloves as evidence handling, B corrects purpose; A covers and expands recycling receipt facts into retail plot.
Passenger and station worker; A copies folded arms as insider code, B cold; A confidently broadens cancellation plot to interview sabotage.
Hosts with talking furniture guest; A copies raised water glass as toast, B only drinking; A covers with service order and recruits napkin/soup hosting.
Dinner hosts; A copies drying cushion as comfort setup, B explains damp seat; A covers and relocates guest then asks B to fetch Mum chair.
